For the glory of the children of God, because they transgressed the law and changed the commandments, a covenant eternal, therefore a curse will devour the earth, since those dwelling on it sinned; the word again brings to the exactness of prophecy; so that some may not think to bring judgments unjustly on the God of all things, who connects the causes with the movements of wrath and clearly announces the faults of those being punished; the earth will mourn, because they transgressed the law and loosened the eternal covenant; and the prophet says the earth will be deserted, for those dwelling on it have sinned; it seems the prophet, since the other cities and the land of the Jews have been punished, brings the faults of those under the law to the middle; for they transgressed the law, he says, considering it as nothing, and turning to another, like a trampling, and paying attention to the teachings of human commandments; since we say that God, the creator of all, has made man from the beginning and has engraved a natural law on him, teaching him to know good and evil; and this, I think, is what is said through the voice of John about the only-begotten Son of God; that He is the true light, which enlightens every man coming into the world, and this we think will happen in the last times, according to the words of the visitation

For it is written that 'in those days, the Lord says, giving my laws into their mind and writing them upon their hearts.' However, those on earth transgressed the innate law guiding us towards knowledge of good and evil and changed the commandments. For being esteemed for good works, they turned towards love of flesh and earthly wisdom. The earth became cursed. For the inhabitants provoked the Creator through numerous transgressions. Because of this, the inhabitants of the earth will be poor and few people will be left. Since the earth became cursed due to the abundance of lawlessness within it, they will be burdened with unexpected poverty and will barely be saved; few and countable people will be left. These things have come to pass in history. Again, we say that in the inner mind, those who will be condemned for many transgressions on the divine throne will certainly be poor and in need.
pass_b_english: Because they have transgressed the law and changed the commandments, thus violating the eternal covenant, a curse will devour the earth, since those who dwell on it have sinned.

The earth will mourn because its inhabitants have transgressed the law and loosened the eternal covenant, and the prophet declares that the earth will be deserted, for those who dwell on it have sinned.

It seems that the prophet, having punished other cities and the land of the Jews, now brings the faults of those under the law to the forefront, as they have transgressed the law, considering it as nothing, and have turned to human commandments.
In doing so, they have trampled the natural law engraved on them by God, which teaches them to know good and evil, for God, the creator of all, has made man from the beginning.

This natural law guides us towards knowledge of good and evil, and it is what is said through the voice of John about the only-begotten Son of God, that He is the true light, which enlightens every man coming into the world (John 1:9).

We believe that this will happen in the last times, according to the words of the visitation, and as it is written, 'in those days, the Lord says, giving my laws into their mind and writing them upon their hearts' (Jeremiah 31:33).
However, those on earth have transgressed this innate law and changed the commandments, for being esteemed for good works, they turned towards love of flesh and earthly wisdom.
As a result, the earth became cursed, and its inhabitants provoked the Creator through numerous transgressions, which is why the people of the earth will be impoverished, and only a few will remain.

This is because the earth has become cursed due to the abundance of lawlessness within it, and its inhabitants will be burdened with unexpected poverty, barely surviving; only a few countable people will be left.
Ultimately, those who will be condemned for their many transgressions on the divine throne will certainly be impoverished and in need.
